payload.title: M13: Rust curriculum: learn Rust by seeing what it compiles to
payload.description: Intent: As the maintainer and the student, I want to learn Rust through the same machine-level lens as C: ownership, borrowing, Option/Result, enums and match, overflow and bounds checks, traits and generics, iterators, shown in the Compilation Explorer (what costs instructions and what compiles to nothing). Depends on Rust practice runs (SIE-02cf3a) and Rust in the explorer. Includes: Rust versions of the Course 4/5 lessons, a 'Rust for C programmers' track for the maintainer, side-by-side C and Rust compiled output lessons, and Rust practice problems in the Workshop.
